examples.title: Basic combobox
examples.description: Type to filter; the list is filtered with a case-insensitive substring match.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Combobox } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const fruits = [
    { value: 'apple', label: 'Apple' },
    { value: 'apricot', label: 'Apricot' },
    { value: 'banana', label: 'Banana' },
    { value: 'blackberry', label: 'Blackberry' },
    { value: 'cherry', label: 'Cherry' },
    { value: 'grape', label: 'Grape' },
    { value: 'mango', label: 'Mango' },
    { value: 'peach', label: 'Peach' },
    { value: 'pineapple', label: 'Pineapple' },
    { value: 'raspberry', label: 'Raspberry' },
  ];

  let selected = $state('');
</script>

<Combobox
  id="fruit"
  label="Favorite fruit"
  placeholder="Start typing…"
  options={fruits}
  bind:value={selected}
/>

examples.title: Disabled combobox
examples.description: Disabled combobox cannot be focused or edited.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Combobox } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  const options = [
    { value: 'free', label: 'Free' },
    { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro' },
    { value: 'enterprise', label: 'Enterprise', disabled: true },
  ];
</script>

<Combobox
  id="combobox-disabled"
  label="Plan"
  placeholder="Locked plan selection"
  {options}
  value="pro"
  disabled
/>

examples.title: Typed options with as const
examples.description: Use `as const` on the options array to infer a precise literal-union type for `T`. TypeScript then rejects any `value` that is not a member of the union (or the empty-string sentinel) at compile time.
examples.code: Selected: {selected || '(none)'}

examples.title: Grouped options
examples.description: Give options a group to render them under headings with counts. Typing filters across groups and keeps the headings of groups that still match.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Combobox } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const workflows = [
    { value: 'chat', label: 'Chat with an agent', group: 'Built in' },
    { value: 'digest', label: 'Daily digest', group: 'Recent' },
    { value: 'triage', label: 'Triage issues', group: 'Built in' },
    { value: 'release', label: 'Release notes', group: 'All workflows' },
    { value: 'review', label: 'Review a pull request', group: 'Recent' },
    { value: 'backup', label: 'Nightly backup', group: 'All workflows' },
  ];

  let selected = $state('');
</script>

<Combobox
  id="workflow"
  label="Workflow"
  placeholder="Search workflows…"
  options={workflows}
  bind:value={selected}
/>

examples.title: Picker with search, footer and descriptions
examples.description: `presentation="picker"` is a button that opens a panel with its own search field. Rows carry a description, the chosen row is checked, and the footer stays below the list, also when nothing matches.
examples.code: `No workflows match “${query}”.`} bind:value={selected} > {#snippet footer()} No match? Create one {/snippet}

examples.title: Event picker with code and meta
examples.description: A raw identifier beside the name, what the event narrows by at the trailing edge, a check before the text, and the match count beside the search field.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Combobox } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const events = [
    { value: 'run.error', label: 'A run fails', code: 'run.error', meta: 'any workflow', group: 'Runs' },
    { value: 'review.requested', label: 'A review is requested', code: 'review.requested', meta: 'any agent', group: 'Reviews' },
    { value: 'goal.failed', label: 'A goal fails', code: 'goal.failed', meta: 'any agent', group: 'Goals' },
    { value: 'schedule.missed', label: 'A schedule misses a run', code: 'schedule.missed', meta: 'any schedule', group: 'Schedules' },
  ];
</script>

<Combobox
  id="event-picker"
  label="Event"
  presentation="picker"
  placeholder="Pick an event"
  searchPlaceholder="Search events"
  options={events}
  selectedIndicator="start"
  matchCountVisible
  value="run.error"
>
  {#snippet footer(context)}
    Showing {context.matchCount} of {context.totalCount} events.
  {/snippet}
</Combobox>

examples.title: Loading and a failed load
examples.description: While loading the field stays a combobox and shows its loading label; after the threshold Skeleton's status line offers Cancel. A failed load shows its message and a retry above the options that did load.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Combobox } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<Combobox
  id="workflow-loading"
  label="Workflow"
  required
  options={[]}
  loading
  loadingLabel="Loading workflows…"
  stillLoadingAfter={10000}
  onCancel={() => {}}
/>

<Combobox
  id="workflow-failed"
  label="Workflow"
  required
  presentation="picker"
  placeholder="Pick a workflow"
  options={[{ value: 'chat', label: 'Chat with an agent', meta: 'built in' }]}
  loadError={{
    title: 'Couldn’t load workflows.',
    description: 'Interborough didn’t answer. Chat with an agent is built in and still works.',
  }}
  onRetry={() => {}}
/>
